declarations.name: ShowfmPlayer
declarations.description: The show.fm podcast player. Set `episode` to play one episode, or `podcast` to play the latest one.

attributes.name: episode
attributes.description: Episode UUID. Plays that one episode and wins over `podcast`.

attributes.name: podcast
attributes.description: Podcast slug or UUID. Plays the latest released episode.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Pins the theme. Absent follows the show's player theme setting.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Player size. The height contract depends on it.

attributes.name: accent
attributes.description: Accent colour as a hex value. Absent follows the show's player colour.

attributes.name: wave
attributes.description: Pins the waveform on or off. Absent follows the show's waveform setting.

attributes.name: api
attributes.description: API origin override, for development and testing only.

attributes.name: heading-level
attributes.description: Wraps the episode title in a heading of this level. Absent, the title is a link and no heading is emitted.

attributes.name: credit
attributes.description: The "Powered by show.fm" footer. `auto` follows the show's plan. It shows once per page, on the first embed that shows it.

attributes.name: load
attributes.description: `click` draws a facade and requests nothing from show.fm until the visitor presses it. `showfm.load()` loads every facade at once.

attributes.name: strings
attributes.description: Overrides for visible strings, by key, usually set as a property. `window.showfmStrings` sets them for every element.

cssParts.description: The card shown when the episode cannot be played.
